description: Returns what TrimCarbon charges to offset an amount of CO₂: a one-time purchase in whole tonnes, and for yearly amounts the monthly and yearly plans. Each option has a link to continue on trimcarbon.com, where the user signs up and pays. This tool does not buy anything. It is for when the user asks what offsetting costs.
